chunks: A people came to the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, and said: O Messenger of Allah, a companion of ours has died and he is afflicted with smallpox; if we wash him, his skin will come off. So he said: Give him tayammum.

Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, said: If water is not found for the deceased with which he may be purified—due to absence of water, or absence of means to access it, or because the water is impure, or because it is mixed water of a kind with which purification is not performed—then he is to be given tayammum with earth and buried. Likewise, if a necessity prevents washing him with water, he is not to be washed with it, and he is to be given tayammum with earth.

Its explanation has already passed in the chapter of ritual washings, and we clarified that when ghusl becomes obligatory and water is unavailable, or one is unable to use it, then the obligation at that time is tayammum, so there is no basis for repeating it.

Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, said: One who is to be killed in legal retaliation is ordered to perform ghusl before his execution, so he performs ghusl as one performs ghusl from janabah, is embalmed with camphor by placing it upon his places of prostration, and is shrouded. Then after that the prescribed punishment is carried out upon him, his neck is struck, and he is buried.

key_terms.مَجْدُورٌ: afflicted with smallpox or a severe eruptive illness
key_terms.نَجَاسَةِ الْمَاءِ: the impurity of the water preventing purification with it
key_terms.يَمِّمُوهُ: give him tayammum as a substitute purification

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a deceased person cannot be washed with water before burial?
ai.summary: This passage gives legal rulings concerning the purification of the deceased when washing with water is impossible or harmful. It establishes that tayammum with earth replaces ghusl in such cases, and it also mentions the procedure for one executed in legal retaliation, who is prepared before the punishment is carried out.
